Description

Sun Dry is a vinyl by "the3thgod"

Description: "it is too sunny out here! Put me backkkkk"

Sun Dry is a secret vinyl that can be found by using 2 dynamite on the x located next to the entrance of Mike's Mines.

Sun Dry can be purchased for $2,400.
